name: Channels
summary: Push messages and alerts from outside, like chat apps or CI, into a running session.
what: A channel is an MCP server, installed as a plugin, that delivers outside events into your open session, and can carry Claude's replies back. You could message Claude from your phone through Telegram while it works on your computer. It is a research preview.

impact.title: Talk from anywhere
impact.detail: Send a request from a chat app and get the reply there.

impact.title: React to events
impact.detail: CI results or alerts reach a session that already has your code open.

impact.title: Stay in control
impact.detail: Pairing and allowlists decide who can send messages.

howItWorks: Install a channel plugin, for example telegram from the official marketplace.
Configure it with its setup command, such as /telegram:configure.
Start Claude Code with --channels and the plugin name.
Pair your account and set an allowlist so only you can send.
Events arrive only while the session is open; Team and Enterprise admins must allow it.

events.note: Added --channels (research preview) so MCP servers can push messages into a session.
